decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.7935. Series context: trend strength 0.8138 and seasonal strength 0.4153; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.15); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 2.548.
